content:
The iPhone Duo is just weeks away, and as a long-time iPad mini fan, I'm excited to see how it recreates the iPad experience when unfolded. Here's a comparison of the iPhone Duo's folding screen with the iPad mini's size.

The iPhone Duo and iPad mini side by side — the Duo is smaller but similar in form factor.

The iPhone Duo is a true two-in-one device — the outer screen delivers the traditional iPhone experience, while the folding screen unfolds to offer iPad mini-like functionality.

But just how similar are the two devices in size?

Here are the overall height and width figures for both devices, as provided by Apple:

iPhone Duo iPad mini Height 4.64 inches 5.3 inches Width 6.48 inches 7.69 inches

However, because the iPhone Duo has much thinner bezels, the gap in screen size isn't as dramatic as you might think.

  • iPhone Duo: 7.6-inch screen
  • iPad mini: 8.3-inch screen

Here's a video posted by Adrián Santos on X showing the two devices side by side:

If you're used to the classic iPad mini size with its 7.9-inch screen, check out this comparison made by Dylan McDonald on X using a paper mockup of the Duo:

What do you think of the iPhone Duo's screen size? Too big or too small? Let us know in the comments.
